> Nowic Studio is a premium software development agency that builds MVPs, SaaS platforms, AI-integrated web applications, and custom digital products for startups and growing businesses worldwide. We combine senior-level engineering with AI-augmented workflows to ship products in weeks, not months.

## About Nowic Studio

Nowic Studio is a boutique software engineering agency founded in 2023. We partner with early-stage founders, funded startups, and SMBs to transform product ideas into polished, scalable software — shipped fast.

**What makes us different:**
- **Execution-First Process**: Sprint-based delivery with weekly demos and clear milestones.
- **AI-Augmented Speed**: We leverage AI development tools to deliver 3× faster without sacrificing quality.
- **Senior-Level Code Quality**: Clean architecture, tested code, scalable infrastructure from day one.
- **Premium UI/UX**: Every product looks and feels premium — because first impressions win customers.

## Our Services

- **MVP Development** — Build a launch-ready minimum viable product in 4–6 weeks. Includes UI/UX design, frontend (React/Next.js), backend (Django/Node.js), database, authentication, and deployment. Starting from $2,499.
- **SaaS Platform Development** — Full-stack SaaS products with multi-tenancy, user authentication, role-based access, Stripe payment integration, admin dashboards, and API layers. Starting from $5,999.
- **AI App Integration** — Integrate LLMs (GPT-4, Claude), chatbots, semantic search (RAG pipelines), vector databases, content generation, and AI agent workflows into existing or new applications. Starting from $3,999.
- **Business Website** — Premium marketing websites designed to convert visitors into clients. Mobile responsive, SEO-optimized, fast-loading. Starting from $1,499.
- **API & Backend Development** — Scalable REST/GraphQL APIs, microservices, background job processing, and database architecture using Python/Django or Node.js.
- **Admin Dashboard & CRM** — Custom internal tools, analytics dashboards, CRM systems, and operational admin panels.

## Tech Stack

- **Frontend**: React, Next.js, Vite, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion
- **Backend**: Python, Django, Django Ninja, Node.js, Express.js
- **Databases**: PostgreSQL, Supabase, SQLite, Redis, MongoDB
- **AI/ML**: OpenAI GPT-4, Anthropic Claude, LangChain, Pinecone, pgvector, RAG pipelines
- **Authentication**: Clerk, Auth.js, JWT, OAuth
- **Payments**: Stripe, Razorpay
- **DevOps**: Render, Vercel, Docker, GitHub Actions, CI/CD
